fonts.name: Inter and Heebo (named in the CSS font stack only)
fonts.usage: No font files are bundled or downloaded. The names are a preference: they are used only if already installed on the visitor's device.

icons.name: Navigation and interface icons
icons.usage: Inline SVG paths. Some shapes follow the Feather icon set (MIT License, © Cole Bemis); others were drawn for this project.

reviewedExceptions.reason: Optional image-optimisation binaries pulled in by Next.js. Used unmodified as a separately loaded library; LGPL allows this. Not shipped to browsers.
